alternative_explanations: Any gain may be ordinary last-byte random-feature prediction or learned unigram bias rather than recurrent temporal memory.

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any frozen corpus hash or byte-length mismatch.
Invalidate if an implementable candidate receives paths, roles, offsets, future bytes or another test slot's state.
Invalidate if test updates change shared slow state or tuning occurs after scoring output.
Invalidate if a mandatory PPM, CTW, LZ or dense autoregressive control is absent.

Invalidate if the three reservoir roles differ in topology, constants, initialization, data order, input representation or output rule beyond the preregistered recurrence and readout-learning interventions.
Invalidate if the no-recurrence role uses recurrent state or if the frozen-readout role changes its readout weights.

confounds: The local visible repository is small, dense autoregressive may exceed the common state cap, and online softmax SGD gives a weak conventional readout.
falsification_criteria: Discard if in any K/D cell recurrent mean, cold or worst-file bpb fails to beat both source-identical ablations by at least 0.1671047931063159; also discard on nonfinite output, state above 4194304 bytes, unequal mean query ops across K at fixed D, or Pareto dominance by a simpler complete implementable control on frozen quality and full-cost axes.

outcome_policy.negative: Falsify this exact width-16 rho-0.9 online-readout reservoir without tuning width, recurrence scale, embedding scale, epoch or learning rate.
outcome_policy.null: End the exact rule if recurrence does not materially beat both source-identical ablations or classical controls dominate full cost.
outcome_policy.positive: Authorize only unchanged three-seed adversarial replication on a later wake.

predicted_outcome: The reservoir may improve over both source-identical ablations, but is expected to miss the frozen 0.1671047931063159 bpb every-cell conjunction or be dominated by PPM-D and CTW.
promotion_criteria: One seed cannot promote; only the complete conjunction may authorize unchanged three-seed adversarial replication in a later wake.
research_question: Can one source-identical width-16 tanh byte system with PCG64(seed xor 0x45534e31), positive-diagonal-canonicalized QR orthogonal recurrence, rho 0.9, normal scale-0.25 byte embeddings, zero bias-plus-state 17x256 readout, one chronological epoch and online multinomial SGD learning rate 0.05 improve temporal prediction over rho-0 and frozen-readout ablations?
title: Orthogonal recurrent reservoir byte scout
